readout: Counts first. The workbook reports macro F1, precision, recall, AUROC, AUPRC and inference per picture at 0.5, with per-class counts, a provisional selected-threshold sheet, a Pass fail block, the 148 truth-pass pictures by class and exact set, and per-class train/validation/test counts. The Pass fail sheet gives one verdict per picture under the agreed rule (TA, FR, TR, FA; TAR, TRR, FAR, FRR). AUROC is computed from the saved test scores; AUPRC is the run's primary.
